scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,worker,web "bun run dev:api" "bun run dev:worker" "bun run dev:web"
scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/backend build && bun run --cwd apps/web build
scripts.lint: bun run --cwd apps/backend lint && bun run --cwd apps/web lint
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/backend typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --cwd apps/backend test && bun run --cwd apps/web test
scripts.check: bun run --cwd apps/backend check && bun run --cwd apps/web check
